title: Headless Dreamer with Butterflies
description: A person in a grey sweater sits on a wooden chair with a glowing crescent moon where their head should be. An open book, a teacup overflowing with blue liquid and paper boats, and numerous blue and white butterflies fill the surreal room.
prompt: Surreal scene of a person wearing a grey sweater and brown pants sitting on a wooden chair inside a dark swirling room, their head replaced by a glowing yellow crescent moon with pink orbs, blue and white butterflies flying everywhere, an open book with cracked pages and a blue teacup spilling liquid with paper boats on a wooden table, dreamy ethereal atmosphere with floating clock faces and mathematical symbols in the background, painterly style
